project_type: Next.js 16 full-stack app with Turbopack, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: npm with next build; prisma generate runs as postinstall and in vercel buildCommand
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files found)
test_command: No test command - verify via build only
verification_instructions: 1. npm install, 2. npx prisma generate, 3. npm run build (should succeed with no errors)
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ is generated by prisma generate from schema
environment_constraints: PostgreSQL required at runtime but build works without DB. No test suite exists. Verify via TypeScript build compilation. createMany does not work reliably with Prisma adapters - use individual creates.
contribution_requirements: Push directly to main. Groundcrew auto-deploys. Error messages must show in UI. LLM calls gracefully degrade without API key. Executive resume writer expertise in prompts.
key_patterns: API routes in src/app/api/ use try/catch with NextResponse.json errors. Pages are client components with useState/useEffect. Prisma client accessed via lazy proxy in src/lib/db.ts. OpenAI used with gpt-4o-mini for extraction and gpt-4o for writing. Skills stored as individual records in JobSkill/ExperienceSkill tables with name field.
directory_structure: src/app/ - Next.js app router pages and API routes; src/lib/ - shared utilities (db, parsers); src/components/ - reusable React components; src/generated/prisma/ - generated Prisma client; prisma/ - schema and migrations
